data.title: Futsuu no Seikatsu
data.synopsis:
Ordinary life repeats itself every day. The succession of moments that we repeat over and over again is never the same, and everything changes and wavers. The moment we touch something, our consciousness can go to a place that does not exist anywhere in the past, nor in the future. In an uncertain and fluctuating world, only the feeling of the body touching something, which exists only in this present reality, can be recognized as "now". That moment is lovely.

(Source: Berlin International Film Festival)

data.title: AOTU Shijie Reborn
data.synopsis:
The Creator of Aotu World is a reckless God who created a universe full of inequality, but also gave the people a chance to change their destiny- Just participate in the "Aotu Tournament" and utilize the "Special Abilities" granted by the system. Pass rounds of cruel tests and strive for the ultimate victory! Now, the tournament, which has been suspended for 100 years, has been reopened.

Our protagonist, King, decides to enter the tournament in order to change the fate of his planet, Dengru, and find his sister...
data.background: A reboot of the original Bilibili series, AOTU Shijie Reborn has similarities to the original series, but with fresh twists.

titles.title: Qing Chi Hong Xiaodou Ba! Shiwu Shijie
请吃红小豆吧！食物世界 第一季

data.title: Qing Chi Hong Xiaodou Ba! Shiwu Shijie
data.title_japanese: 请吃红小豆吧！食物世界 第一季
data.synopsis:
Have you ever wondered where uneaten food goes? Wasted food actually goes to a world that belongs only to food, which is simply called the "Food City." Food is cleaned, disinfected and repaired here, and then returns to the human world to "go to work" and reappear in human bowls! Red Bean is just a red bean that is not eaten day after day... But one day, an accident happened! While Red Bean was working diligently, a human diner suddenly got food poisoning, and Red Bean became the object of suspicion by the Food Inspection Bureau...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

titles.title: 島津製作所 創業150周年記念アニメーション

data.title: Shimazu Seisakusho Sougyou 150-shuunen Kinen Animation
data.title_japanese: 島津製作所 創業150周年記念アニメーション
data.synopsis:
The story takes place in Kyoto in 1877. The atmosphere of the city and people in Kyoto was greatly depressed due to the transfer of the capital to Tokyo. Despite this, Genzo Shimadzu Sr. was busily pursuing his research with the aim of flying a light balloon requested by Kyoto Prefecture. After watching the balloon take off, the protagonist (Shimadzu employee) aspires to connect Genzo's passion from the past to the present and into the future.

(Source: Official YouTube channel)
